verdict.rationale: Any public web service could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows such a file or agent docs. The crawled material covers ordinary portal functions (search, filing, ordering copies, subscriptions). The probes show the main sos.state.mn.us landing page is a Radware CAPTCHA interstitial for keyless agents, with no llms.txt and no robots.txt (404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
